question: For how many families did the builder, or its shared host, change after the committed fixtures were last written?
answer: 145 of 346. 111 of those carry a RASTER_PASS and 96 are COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN.
thisNumberOverstates: Today's repair lanes deliberately changed builders without moving a byte -- FIX169, FIX170 and FIX166 each proved byte-identical fixtures after their edits -- and every one of those edits counts here as fresh exposure. A builder edit that provably did not move the output is exposure by this measure and not by any other.
whatThisMeasuresAndWhatItDoesNot: This is EXPOSURE, not drift. It compares the last commit touching the builder and its shared host against the last commit touching the family's fixtures/ directory. Code changing later does not mean the output moved -- lanes have repeatedly rebuilt such families to byte-identical fixtures. Only a rebuild settles it either way, and this record does not rebuild anything.
whyItWasMeasured: FIX168 ran a determinism control on sd_arrest_expungement-set and found the committed artifacts are the output of code that no longer exists in the tree: canonical 627e6502->8c9c1c83 and boundary 79b2e9ac->195f7776 (+51 bytes each), production-field-map.json 992 insertions / 354 deletions, requiredBeforeFilingCount 107->28, and product-wiring.json's entire binding block deleted. The map and fixtures were last written at ab25f51fa; the builder changed at 41f14826c and its shared host at b467824f1.

measuredToRefuseRatherThanReproduce: ne-setaside-custodial-set (FIX171): the unmodified builder refuses on four unnamed blanks after writing both fixtures, and left 8 modified files behind

theRealRisk: Where the artifacts do not reproduce, the family's RASTER_PASS is hostage to the next rebuild: curing anything moves bytes and burns the binding. FIX168 declined to cure SD for exactly that reason, and was right to.
theCure: A per-family rebuild-reproducibility check, run as a determinism control before any repair, is what every lane in this fleet already does by hand. Making it a script would turn 143 unknowns into 143 answers without a lane each.
decidesNothing: No family is demoted and no receipt withdrawn by this record.
